title: Water Ripple
description: A reactive dot lattice behind the content. Moving the pointer or tapping sends ripples, broken data columns and delayed flares through it.

color.label: Dot color
color.help: None uses the text color of the section.

highlight.label: Highlight color
highlight.help: Only the strongest flares reach it.

intensity.label: Reaction strength
intensity.help: Lower values let the lattice sit quietly behind long text.

drift.label: Ambient drift
drift.help: Broad dithered bands roll across the lattice. At 0 a settled lattice stops animating.

variations.name: drifting
variations.title: Drifting Ripple
variations.description: The water lattice with slow ambient bands, also when nobody moves the pointer.
